body: UPDATE: There will reportedly be no verdict in Lil Durk @lildurk’s trial today as jurors continue reviewing the evidence. 👀 The jury has requested all evidence in digital form. Judge Fitzgerald reportedly said those materials will be available tomorrow morning at 8:30 a.m., allowing jurors to continue their review as deliberations move forward. A verdict tomorrow is not guaranteed. For now, the wait continues for Durk, his family and fans following the case. 📸: Alberto E. Rodriguez / Getty Images

UPDATE: There will reportedly be no verdict in Lil Durk’s trial today as jurors continue reviewing the evidence. 👀

The jury has requested all evidence in digital form. Judge Fitzgerald reportedly said those materials will be available tomorrow morning at 8:30 a.m., allowing jurors to continue their review as deliberations move forward.

A verdict tomorrow is not guaranteed. For now, the wait continues for Durk, his family and fans following the case.

📸: Alberto E. Rodriguez / Getty Images
